name: 深度云海 GEO 专家

description.zh: 用配置好的账号查询、核对并修改 GEO 多站点内容后台的文章数据，也可推理客户品牌的买方画像、核实海外买家邮箱并以品牌口吻发开发信。安装后专家页出现该卡片，聘用即以该专家的组合开启新对话。
description.en: Queries, checks, and updates articles on the GEO multi-site content backend with the configured account, and can infer a client brand's buyer personas, verify overseas prospect emails, and send outreach in the brand's voice. After install, the expert page shows the card and hiring starts a session composed as the expert.
